Summary: Peace — shalom — is wholeness with God, with others, and within ourselves, lost in the Fall and restored through Christ who is our peace. Jesus gives a peace the world cannot give, guarding hearts and minds even in trouble. One day the Prince of Peace will reign, and swords will become ploughshares.
KeyPassages: Numbers 6:24-26; Isaiah 9:6; John 14:27; Romans 5:1; Ephesians 2:14; Philippians 4:7
RelatedBooks: Numbers; Isaiah; John; Romans; Ephesians; Philippians
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; The Crucifixion; The Resurrection
